properties.text: P256VERIFY must accept valid secp256r1 signatures and reject all invalid ones deterministically.
properties.assertion: forall (h,r,s,qx,qy): p256verify(h,r,s,qx,qy) == true iff ECDSA_verify(h,r,s,(qx,qy)) == true

properties.text: Point-at-infinity check on R' is required; skipping it allows signature forgery (RIP-7212 fix).
properties.assertion: forall verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): R_prime == POINT_AT_INFINITY => return false

properties.text: Final comparison must use r' == r (mod n), not direct equality; wrong reduction enables forgery.
properties.assertion: forall verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): compare(R_prime.x, r) == (R_prime.x mod n == r mod n)

properties.text: Blob commitment count in block must not exceed get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block.
properties.assertion: forall block b: len(b.body.blob_kzg_commitments) <= get_blob_parameters(epoch(b)).max_blobs_per_block

properties.text: Fork digest must incorporate blob parameters; mismatched digests cause network partition.
properties.assertion: forall epoch e: fork_digest(e) == trunc4(fork_data_root(e) XOR hash(blob_params(e)))

properties.text: Proposer lookahead length must always be (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH after epoch processing.
properties.assertion: forall state s post epoch: len(s.proposer_lookahead) == (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1)*SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: Execution payload parent_hash must chain to state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash.
properties.assertion: forall payload p: p.parent_hash == state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash

properties.text: Execution payload timestamp must equal compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot).
properties.assertion: forall payload p: p.timestamp == compute_time_at_slot(state, state.slot)

properties.text: Execution payload prev_randao must equal current epoch's randao mix.
properties.assertion: forall payload p: p.prev_randao == get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state))

properties.text: Input r and s must satisfy 0 < value < n (secp256r1 subgroup order) before verification.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): (0 < r < n) AND (0 < s < n)

properties.text: Public key point (qx,qy) must lie on the secp256r1 curve and not be the point at infinity.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): (qy^2 == qx^3+a*qx+b mod p) AND (qx,qy)!=(0,0)

properties.text: P256VERIFY must never revert; all invalid inputs return empty output, not an EVM exception.
properties.assertion: forall input I: p256verify(I) terminates AND (returns 32-byte result OR returns empty)

properties.text: All 15 epoch sub-processes must execute in strict sequential order; reordering corrupts state.
properties.assertion: forall epoch transition: exec_order == [just,inact,rewards,reg,slash,eth1,dep,consol,bal,sr,rand,hist,part,sync,lookahead]

properties.text: process_proposer_lookahead must run after all balance/registry updates in epoch processing.
properties.assertion: forall epoch: process_proposer_lookahead executes after process_effective_balance_updates

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all received blocks and attestations must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall msg from P2P: validate(msg) == true before state_transition(msg)

properties.text: Transaction calldata is arbitrary; precompile must handle all 160-byte inputs without revert.
properties.assertion: forall tx calling P256VERIFY: |tx.data| in {0..MAX} => no revert (except OOG)

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated but EL data may not be independently verified by CL.
properties.assertion: forall engine_api_call: jwt_authenticated(call) == true; data integrity is semi-trusted

properties.text: BLOB_SCHEDULE configuration entries have unique epoch values all >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH.
properties.assertion: forall e1,e2 in BLOB_SCHEDULE: e1!=e2 => e1.EPOCH!=e2.EPOCH; all EPOCH>=FULU_FORK_EPOCH

properties.text: Proposer selection is deterministic; same state and seed always yield same proposer sequence.
properties.assertion: forall state s, seed d: compute_proposer_indices(s, e, d, idx) is pure and deterministic

properties.text: Input validation checks must execute in order: length, r, s, qx, qy, curve, infinity.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify input: validation_order == [len_check, r_bounds, s_bounds, qx_bounds, qy_bounds, curve_eq, inf_check]

properties.text: Input is exactly 160 bytes split into five 32-byte BigEndian fields: h, r, s, qx, qy.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(input): |input|==160 AND fields==[input[0:32],input[32:64],input[64:96],input[96:128],input[128:160]]

properties.text: Field bounds check must use field modulus p, not subgroup order n, for qx and qy.
properties.assertion: forall point_check(qx,qy): bounds_check uses p (field modulus), NOT n (subgroup order)

properties.text: Gas cost is fixed at 6900 regardless of input validity or execution path.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(input): gas_consumed == 6900 (when available_gas >= 6900)

properties.text: All BLOB_SCHEDULE max_blobs_per_block values must be <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
properties.assertion: forall entry in BLOB_SCHEDULE: entry.max_blobs_per_block <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK

properties.text: get_blob_parameters must return Electra defaults when no BLOB_SCHEDULE entry matches.
properties.assertion: forall epoch e where no schedule match: get_blob_parameters(e)==BlobParameters(ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, MAX_BLOBS_ELECTRA)

properties.text: Modular inverse s^(-1) must be computed mod n (subgroup order), not mod p (field modulus).
properties.assertion: forall verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): s1 == modular_inverse(s, n) where n is secp256r1 subgroup order

properties.text: After epoch processing, proposer_lookahead contains valid proposers for next MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 epochs.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N post: proposer_lookahead covers slots [N..N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD] with valid indices

properties.text: After proposer_lookahead shift, earliest epoch entries are removed and new epoch appended.
properties.assertion: forall process_proposer_lookahead: lookahead[0:last_start]==old_lookahead[SLOTS_PER_EPOCH:]

properties.text: After process_execution_payload, state.latest_execution_payload_header reflects the new payload.
properties.assertion: forall process_execution_payload(state, body): state.latest_execution_payload_header == Header(body.execution_payload)

properties.text: New proposers computed at epoch N boundary must use state after all N's balance/registry updates.
properties.assertion: forall epoch N: proposers_for(N+LOOKAHEAD+1) computed AFTER effective_balance_updates(N)

properties.text: get_beacon_proposer_index must return proposer_lookahead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH], not recompute.
properties.assertion: forall slot s: get_beacon_proposer_index(state,s)==state.proposer_lookahead[s%SLOTS_PER_EPOCH]

properties.text: P256VERIFY must return exactly 32 bytes (0x01 padded) on success, 0 bytes on failure.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(input): (verified => |output|==32 AND output==0x01) AND (!verified => |output|==0)

properties.text: Scalar multiplication and point addition must use secp256r1 curve parameters, not secp256k1.
properties.assertion: forall ec_ops in p256verify: curve_params == SECP256R1_PARAMS (a,b,p,n,G)

properties.text: All proposer indices in lookahead must reference active validators for the target epoch.
properties.assertion: forall idx in proposer_lookahead: idx in get_active_validator_indices(state, target_epoch(idx))

properties.text: Exactly SLOTS_PER_EPOCH proposer indices must be computed per epoch in compute_proposer_indices.
properties.assertion: forall compute_proposer_indices(state,epoch,seed,idx): |result| == SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

properties.text: Proposer seed for each slot must be uniquely derived from base seed and slot offset.
properties.assertion: forall i,j in 0..SLOTS_PER_EPOCH where i!=j: seed_i != seed_j (hash(seed+slot_i) != hash(seed+slot_j))

properties.text: P256VERIFY results must be identical across all client implementations for the same input.
properties.assertion: forall clients C1,C2, input I: C1.p256verify(I) == C2.p256verify(I)

properties.text: Timing of secp256r1 operations must be constant-time to prevent secret key recovery via side channels.
properties.assertion: forall p256verify(input): execution_time independent_of input values (constant-time impl)

properties.text: Gas cost 6900 must cover worst-case computation; underpricing enables CPU-exhaustion DoS.
properties.assertion: forall input I: actual_compute_cost(p256verify(I)) <= 6900 * GAS_TO_CPU_RATIO

properties.text: Fork digest must differ when blob parameters change, even if fork version is unchanged (EIP-7892).
properties.assertion: forall e1,e2: blob_params(e1)!=blob_params(e2) => fork_digest(e1)!=fork_digest(e2)

properties.text: Cached proposer lookahead must produce same result as on-demand computation for the same state.
properties.assertion: forall slot s: state.proposer_lookahead[s%SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] == compute_proposer_index_fresh(state,s)

properties.text: get_blob_parameters sorted schedule must select the highest-epoch entry not exceeding the query epoch.
properties.assertion: forall epoch e: get_blob_parameters(e) == entry with max(entry.EPOCH) where entry.EPOCH <= e

properties.text: Proposer seed uses DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER for domain separation; wrong domain breaks consensus.
properties.assertion: forall get_beacon_proposer_indices(state,epoch): seed == get_seed(state,epoch,DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER)

properties.text: Proposer lookahead at epoch N start must have N+1 epoch proposers available (deterministic lookahead).
properties.assertion: forall epoch N boundary: proposer_lookahead contains valid proposers for epoch N+1 slots
